name_zh: 好用服务间一班开门账
purpose_zh: 把一班开放的时间、功能工时、开门证据、故障响应和六项询价对象放在同一张工作单上，让运营方能先核责任与工作量，再决定是否报价和开放。
purpose_en: Put one opening shift's clock, functional effort, release evidence, fault response, and six quote objects on one work order so an operator can verify responsibility and workload before pricing or opening.

reference_shift.labour_rule: The figures below are functional-role minutes for quote comparison. They are not a headcount, roster, employment standard, or permission to place one person on an overlong shift. Actual people, breaks, substitutions, overlap, and labour compliance remain operator decisions.

functional_role_minutes.coverage: T-60 route check through T+480 close, plus 45-minute reconciliation
T-30 manual replay through T+480 close
pre-open route check and one complete midday no-app replay
physical-stop check and one announced fault-card rehearsal
source and expiry check plus closing deletion countercheck

seven_checkpoints.human_action: walk the ordinary and no-app route
seven_checkpoints.release_rule: blocked segment means do not open

seven_checkpoints.human_action: replay the complete paper task and physical stop
seven_checkpoints.release_rule: failed manual task means no assisted opening

seven_checkpoints.human_action: read source date, expiry, minimum data, and stop rule with staff
open only the accepted operating state and show the human point
seven_checkpoints.release_rule: public label must match manual, assisted, degraded, or closed state
failed replay withdraws the affected route

seven_checkpoints.human_action: run one announced fault card with no unsuspecting visitor
seven_checkpoints.release_rule: failed takeover stops the affected service

seven_checkpoints.human_action: close, reconcile issues, delete expired test data, and record the next state
seven_checkpoints.release_rule: missing close evidence keeps the service closed

response_boundaries.required_action: stop the affected assistance, cover the interface, and show the current manual or closed state
response_boundaries.proof: timestamped state change and issue id

response_boundaries.required_action: a present staff member accepts the task or the service records that it cannot proceed
response_boundaries.proof: human verifier field or explicit no-issue record

response_boundaries.required_action: turn off the affected interface and replay the staffed paper path
give an issue id, responsible functional role, and an accepted next-review date
response_boundaries.proof: paper issue stub without personal data

response_boundaries.required_action: reconcile issue status, expired test data, paper versions, and the next operating state
produce the category-specific recovery evidence and an independent same-task replay
response_boundaries.proof: reopen evidence pack linked to the fault card

cards.acceptance: dated route pack, privacy check, limitations, and evidence acceptance sheet

cards.reference_quantity: 3 stationed paper sets + 1 accessible-format master per Works Bay
cards.acceptance: source owner, version date, expiry, large-print check, and weekly replacement method

cards.reference_quantity: 1 reversible 6.0 m x 4.8 m trial set
cards.acceptance: assembly, clear-route, dual-height counter, removal, and surface-restoration checks

cards.reference_quantity: 1 bounded test article at a time
cards.acceptance: physical stop, route bypass, power isolation, equipment removal, and incident replay

cards.reference_quantity: 21.5 functional-role hours per 8-hour public reference shift
cards.acceptance: all seven checkpoints covered, substitutions named, manual route demonstrated, and close reconciled
no permanent civil, building, utility, or corridor work enters the pilot quote
excluded_until_authorized: all permanent works pending a formal project

originality_boundary: This shift book is rebuilt from JING-ZHANG WORKS' own Works Bay, paper task, seven existing clock checks, six cost lines, and six fault cards. It does not reuse any peer name, field combination, schema, staffing formula, price band, wording, drawing, code, or asset.
claim_boundary_zh: 这是一份便于询价和排演的参考班次工作单。21.5 小时只表示五类功能覆盖量，不是人数、排班、工资、法定工时或预算。场地、日期、具名人员、班次数、报价、总价、许可和现场结果仍为空。
claim_boundary_en: This is a reference-shift work order for quote comparison and rehearsal. The 21.5 hours measure five functional coverage tasks, not headcount, roster, wages, legal hours, or budget. Site, date, named people, shift count, quotations, total price, permits, and field results remain empty.
